summary: Cisco delivered a broad Q4 beat and a major forward reset: FY27 guidance of $72.2–73.4B and $5.05–5.11 materially exceeds the priced-in ~$68.8B/$4.80 bar, while Q1 guidance, $7.5B AI revenue expectations, orders, margins and RPO corroborate the acceleration. The package clears the structural-upside threshold despite elevated positioning.
